messages:
eva-cs: customer reported a weird promo behavior — when they call the /v1/accounts/:id/promos/apply endpoint with two promo codes back-to-back, the second one overwrites the first instead of stacking. they provided account_id=acct_9x2 and request/response logs.
sarah-support: got it. can you paste the exact curl/JSON they used? also what's the expected stacking rule for that account?
eva-cs: (sorry typo) here: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/acct_9x2/promos/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"code": "NEWUSER100", "apply_as": "credit"}'
\n# then immediately:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/acct_9x2/promos/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"code": "SPRING50", "apply_as": "credit"}'
```
eva-cs: responses: first returned 200 + {"balance_delta":100}, second returned 200 + {"balance":50}, and the account__promo_entries shows only SPRING50 active. customer expects both to coexist because NEWUSER100 is a trial grant and SPRING50 is a percent coupon; our docs say "non-conflicting promos should stack".
sarah-support: weird. can you attach the raw response bodies or screenshot of billing UI showing the missing credit?
eva-cs: pasted raw JSON into the ticket: first response body: {"ok":true,"applied":"NEWUSER100","type":"grant","amount":100,"remaining_balance":100}  second: {"ok":true,"applied":"SPRING50","type":"percentage","amount":null,"remaining_balance":50}  ui shows balance 50.
mike-billing: tagging in — seems like we reduced remaining_balance instead of adding. did we run a migration earlier that changed how grants are stored?
ryan-engineer: @mike-billing I pulled up the apply codepath. the handler calls PromoService.applyPromo(accountId, code) which internally checks for existing active promos and if any exist with "mutually_exclusive": true it will replace. looks like NEWUSER100 was missing the meta flag on onboarding grants so it defaulted to exclusive=true. i can repro locally: apply NEWUSER100 then SPRING50 -> last one wins.
sarah-support: can we confirm whether the API should accept a param to force stack? maybe a boolean in the API we never documented?
ryan-engineer: there is an optional query param ?mode=merge vs ?mode=replace in the old v0 API, but the v1 endpoint drops the param and chooses replace semantics by default. i think when we rolled promos to v1 we simplified behavior and unintentionally changed stacking.
mike-billing: consequences: customers may lose trial credits when they apply a coupon later — billing could be undercharged or user confusion. we should offer immediate remediation if possible.
eva-cs: customer asked for a manual restore of the NEWUSER100 grant on acct_9x2 and a note explaining why.
ryan-engineer: short-term: we can manually credit 100 to the account (billing team) and mark promo history entry. i'll raise a fix to reintroduce explicit stacking rules based on promo metadata (type-based stacking) + add ?stack=true param. i'll create a PR and a migration to mark onboarding grants with "mutually_exclusive": false.
mike-billing: manual credit done: +100 applied, invoice adjusted, note added to account. told customer.
sarah-support: excellent. can we also add a diagnostic to detect accounts with mixed promo types that were migrated and might be flagged exclusive=true incorrectly? would help find other affected customers.
ryan-engineer: yes, I'll run a query: SELECT account_id FROM promo_entries WHERE type IN ('grant','percentage') AND mutually_exclusive = true LIMIT 1000 — will send list by EOD. also opening a bug: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4287 with repro steps and suggested patch.
eva-cs: customer confirmed restored credits and appreciated the explanation. they asked if future applies will stack automatically.
ryan-engineer: until patch lands, behavior stays replace-by-default on v1. workaround for customers: apply the higher-value grant last (so it wins) or request manual credit from support. doc update + changelog entry planned.
sarah-support: I'll update the support KB with the workaround and link to the GH issue. tagging promo-bot in case we want an automated detection.
promo-bot: detected 12 accounts with potential migration-induced exclusive=true flags. scheduled report for tomorrow.
sarah-support: thanks everyone — closing thread after follow-up doc + PR merged. :white_check_mark:
